issues.issue: The report prints motor vehicle taxes of 152,932 as a separate tax line on the Statement of Activities. The fund statement's Intergovernmental line contains it, so no motor vehicle tax appears anywhere in the JSON. The extractor did not split it out and flagged it for review. Whether to split Intergovernmental (a non-tax line) by the Statement of Activities is a judgment call. The amount is likely inside the General Fund's intergovernmental receipts (detail[3] State 336,701 / detail[4] Local 526,530), but the schedules do not show which.

The line is broad. The fund statement (p4) gives the General Fund 370,802 of charges for services and 492,428 of intergovernmental, while the schedule shows State 336,701 + Local 526,530. Charges for services is the most likely majority of Local (about 70% if all 370,802 is in it), but the split is not printed. The line already has a review note.
